newsitem.title: USA: US jet inches up as firmer diffs offset futures.
newsitem.headline: US jet inches up as firmer diffs offset futures.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were talked higher Tuesday as firmer differentials offset lower futures, but prices were hard to nail down in skimpy trade, players said.
"The market is so thin that prices are a moving target," one Gulf player said, adding a small purchase by a major refiner helped 54-grade diffs firm 0.35 cent to about 0.15 below the print.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at about 2.40 cents over the print, about 0.40 cent firmer than Monday differentials, players said.
